description.en: R. Yishmael (b. Elisha) was the head of an academy and intellectual rival of [R. Akiva](https://www.sefaria.org/topics/rabbi-akiva?tab=sources) at a time of harsh Roman persecution. His teachings had an important impact on Jewish law and thought. Perhaps most famous among his teachings are his [thirteen exegetical principles], recited daily by many. The tannaitic midrashic works of the [Mekhilta DeRabbi Yishmael](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael?tab=contents) and [Sifrei Bamidbar](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifrei_Bamidbar?tab=contents) are products of his school.
description.he: רבי ישמעאל היה ראש בית מדרש ובר־פלוגתא של רבי עקיבא בתקופת רדיפות הרומאים. לתלמודו הייתה השפעה ניכרת על התפתחות ההלכה והמחשבה היהודית. לימוד ידוע במיוחד שלו הוא פירוט י"ג מידות שהתורה נדרשת בהן.
